decisions.reason: Moving and reorienting sensor-board connectors does not change the three-board architecture or the assigned roles and exclusions of the boards.
The source decision concerns bottom connectors on the sensor board, not the power board's dimensions, mounting, orientation, or connector clearances.
Sensor-board connector placement does not alter the ESP32 antenna requirement on the main-board edge.

The source specifies a connector-placement remedy owned by the separate connector-layout Requirement; it does not change an existing sensor-board dimension or routability acceptance attribute in this candidate.
Moving sensor-board bottom connectors does not change ESP32 pin coverage, breakout format, placement freedom, or platform purpose on the main board.
The source applies the earlier main-board handling approach to the sensor board but does not change the main board's dimensions or prototype adjustability.
Sensor-board connector placement and orientation do not affect the power board's layer count or grounding strategy.
The connector hub's role, connector matrix, pinouts, and total connector count remain unchanged; physical placement and orientation are independently represented by the source Requirement.
Repositioning sensor-board connectors does not change the interboard power topology, connector type, reference, pin count, or pinout.
The source changes only physical connector placement and orientation; the interboard signal connector selection, reference, type, pitch, pin count, and pinout remain valid.
The source concerns sensor-board bottom connectors and does not alter the main-board panel reset connector or its electrical and physical behavior.
Changing sensor-board connector placement does not alter monitored rails, INA219 topology, measurement coverage, or spare monitoring channels.
